style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, dry deadpan satire, vertical 9:16 frame, taller than wide
motion_rule: she is already running along the bough in frame one and never sits, the grove tearing past her every beat; the camera tracks sideways alongside her to a new shot size each beat, reversing at 0.40, 1.05, 3.60 and 6.70; her muzzle never under a third of frame, jaw visible; she never runs at the camera on her feet
character: a wiry macaque in a grey waistcoat and a tall pointed clown cap, running the boughs, exactly two arms, muzzle and jaw clear
second_characters: A SWARM of creditors in grey suits climbing the trunks at her, ONE a shoulder from the lens every beat, two in the first second; all moving
props: ONE carrying pole across her shoulders; ONE sack of pale jute roped to each end, same cloth and size, the left stencilled ДОЛГИ, the right ИПОТЕКА, one big black Cyrillic word each; A SWARM of paper slips inside the sacks; ONE fistful of iron weights, gone by 1.05
prop_continuity: the clown cap stays on her head all clip, the pole rides on her shoulders, both sacks stay roped to its ends
environment: a grove packed wall to wall with boughs and climbers a shoulder from the lens, torn leaves across the glass, a market street below
light_events: white noon, shafts through the leaves sweeping her every beat

audio.delivery: a level pleased female voice, even 3.9 syllables per second, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: GIR-ki, do-LOY, SLE-va, dol-GI, SPRA-va, i-po-TE-ka, ba-LANS, so-SHOL-sya, PRO-sto, o-BE-ikh, sto-RON
audio.pacing: speech runs unbroken 0.00 to 7.20, first word on frame one; after 7.20 leaves, boots and paper fill the track to 10.00
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: boughs whipping, the roar of the grove, boots on bark

timeline.a: she is already running along the bough in the first frame, the weights already flying from her fist past the lens, leaves tearing past, ONE creditor a shoulder away
her left shoulder drives the left sack across frame to the lens, its whole word inside the frame, the bough bending under her stride
her right shoulder drives the right sack to the lens the same way, its whole word inside the frame, and she runs on
she swings the pole and both sacks sweep the bough like a swing-boat, knocking TWO climbing creditors off it across frame
she yanks the left rope mid-stride, a jet of slips into the nearest creditor's face
she yanks the right rope the same way, the same jet of slips into the same face
she runs on into the next tree, the pole and both sacks sweeping the frame
the creditors swarm the trunk and she rides the bending bough down across frame, her muzzle filling the glass
she swings in on a vine across frame and past the lens through the paper, jaw open, the cap over one eye

must_appear: the clown cap on her head in every beat; ДОЛГИ on the left sack, ИПОТЕКА on the right, each word whole, never cropped by the frame edge, readable at 3.60; the left sack opened at 4.90 and the right at 6.70 by the same yank, the same slips from both; nothing touches her before 7.20; every word spoken, the last by 7.20
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal frame, a static camera, a still background, a still first frame, a held pose, a hero sitting on a branch, a cart, a cap blowing off, a word cut by the frame edge, a hero running at the camera on her feet, a wide or distant hero, slow motion, digits, a word not in the lines, a closed jaw while speaking, hands grabbing or carrying the hero before 7.20, multiple monkeys, foreign accent
